posts.name: X-metal
posts.cooked:
Hello dear forumites. It is I, X-metal, here to ask what your favorite moments in sentinel comics were. Lets please keep these confined to canon events stated in the letters page by the masters of the multiverse: christopher and adam. 

 

I'd have to say one of my favorites is the failed card game in the publishing-verse. That's hilarious. Getting into canon, or more acurately, animated canon: the animated series christmas episode. Theres also the adventures of ansel g mouro and mainstay and chrono ranger making ambuscade rethink his life.
